what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the Whalen Sales and Service used-car and repair license renewal hearing to July 24 at eight o'clock.
A motion to continue was made and seconded; the vote was not audible in the recording.
Members said the lot was not ready, with junk and equipment still on it and the Board of Health's final inspection pending.
The applicant was told the next hearing will not be continued again and must show the property cleaned up as it really is.
The applicant was asked to put his wintertime use plans for the property in writing.

why_it_matters: The license renewal for a used-car and repair lot on Whalen Road stays undecided until the July hearing, and neighbors' concerns about equipment, snow clearing and road traffic remain part of the record the board will weigh.
watch_next: Continued hearing on July 24 at eight o'clock, a time certain after another hearing.
The Board of Health's final inspection and the applicant's written wintertime use plans.
